descriptionBandPages: Manage the band pages to display information about the bands.

editor.saveFirst: Save the page before uploading its photograph.
editor.imageHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MiB and 20 megapixels. Uploading saves the image immediately.
editor.caption: Photograph caption
editor.mediaHelp: Use HTTPS file URLs: MP3, M4A, OGG or WAV for audio; MP4 or WebM for video; WebVTT (.vtt) for captions. Provide captions for spoken video. No autoplay.
editor.error: Could not save. Check your permissions, connection, colour, locale text and media URLs. Images must be JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MiB and 20 megapixels.
editor.translationHelp: Edit each language separately. Missing translations show the existing text; saving blank descriptions displays no text.

gigEditor.title: Gigs and ticket prices
gigEditor.help: Add and edit gigs here. Times use Europe/Berlin. Past gigs remain editable and are hidden from the public page.
gigEditor.error: Could not complete the request. Check access, connection and all fields. Enter a valid Berlin date/time, a city, and at least one ticket description and non-negative euro price.
gigEditor.confirmDelete: Delete this gig and its ticket prices?
gigEditor.fallback: Missing translations show the existing text. Enter venue and ticket descriptions separately for each language.
